one_line: Imperial Pandya monarch of Madurai who ruled a wealthy coastal realm and intervened in Sri Lankan affairs in the late 13th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, athletic but solidly built with a regal, battle-tested presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, and strong jaw; warm medium-brown Dravidian complexion; sharp, slightly upturned anime eyes with dark irises; a small vertical tilak in sandalwood paste on the forehead; default expression calm and composed, with a hint of watchfulness.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair gathered into a high, tight knotted bun at the back of the crown (kudumi-style), with neatly combed sides; a simple gold circlet-crown hugging the head with a small central lotus motif, and a narrow cloth band (deep red) under it to keep the hair in place; well-groomed short moustache that follows the upper lip and slightly tapers at the ends, no beard.
appearance.costume: He wears a late-medieval South Indian royal ensemble: a knee-length off-white silk dhoti with a narrow gold border, tightly wrapped and pleated in front, secured with a broad gold-embroidered belt; over this, a deep indigo, fine-cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped from the left shoulder diagonally across the torso and tucked at the waist, leaving both shoulders covered modestly with folds; on top he has a sleeveless fitted vest-like garment in muted maroon with subtle floral brocade, ending just at the belt; his arms carry simple armlets and bangles in dull gold with minimal stone inlay, and he wears a single long, slightly heavy gold necklace with a small, round pendant; ears have medium-sized, disc-shaped gold earrings; ankles have thin anklets visible above sturdy dark-brown leather sandals, practical for campaign and court; the overall silhouette is elegant, functional and court-appropriate, reflecting the wealth of Madurai and the Ma'abar coast without excessive fantasy ornament.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged South Indian sword (similar to an early urumi-sheathed or long-bladed sabre) with a slightly curved steel blade about as long as his arm, a plain cross-guard and a gently flared pommel wrapped in dark-brown leather, sheathed in a dark teakwood scabbard with simple brass fittings, worn at his left hip and often held resting lightly in his right hand.

ref_desc: Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I is a medium-brown, oval-faced Dravidian king with a high knotted black hair bun under a simple gold circlet, short moustache, off-white silk dhoti, maroon brocade vest, deep indigo upper cloth, modest gold jewellery and a leather-hilted South Indian sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I, a late 13th-century South Indian king from Madurai: he has an oval face, warm medium-brown Dravidian complexion, sharp dark anime eyes, a small vertical sandalwood tilak on his forehead, and a calm, watchful expression; his thick black hair is pulled into a high knotted bun at the back of the crown (kudumi-style) with neatly combed sides, held in place by a simple gold circlet-crown with a small central lotus motif and a narrow deep red cloth band beneath; he wears a knee-length off-white silk dhoti with a narrow gold border, precisely wrapped and pleated, secured by a broad gold-embroidered belt, a fitted sleeveless maroon brocade vest that ends at the belt, and a deep indigo fine-cotton upper cloth draped diagonally from the left shoulder across the torso and around both shoulders in modest, layered folds; his jewellery is dignified and not excessive: disc-shaped gold earrings, simple dull-gold armlets and bangles, a single long necklace with a small round pendant, and thin anklets; on his feet are sturdy dark-brown leather sandals; at his left hip hangs his signature straight, slightly curved South Indian steel sword in a dark teakwood scabbard with brass fittings, its leather-wrapped hilt sometimes resting lightly in his right hand; keep the palette to deep indigo, off-white, maroon, dull gold and dark brown, with clean lines and consistent details so the character can be redrawn identically from multiple angles.
